say:1:1028435001:0.text: Did you hear that? I think the trees here are full of gleamtails.
say:1:1028435001:0.source_cn: 你们听到没有？树上全是荧尾鼠发出的细碎声音。

say:3:1028435002:0.text: That teacher from Jade Lake Academy said that we need one male and one female gleamtail... But how can we catch them? We hear them. However, I haven't seen one running around.
say:3:1028435002:0.source_cn: 那个翡湖学院的老师说，需要荧尾鼠公母各一只……不过要怎...

say:4:1028435003:1.text: They're timid creatures. They won't come out if they think people are near.
say:4:1028435003:1.source_cn: 啊，那些家伙胆子小，有人在绝对不敢出来。

say:5:1028435004:0.text: We can lure them out with food. What did like to eat again...?
say:5:1028435004:0.source_cn: 记得它们喜欢吃什么东西来着，可以用食物把它们引诱出来……

say:6:1028435005:0.text: <style="highlight">Wisteria vine</style>! Yes, we should be able to find some around here.

choice_prompt:7:1028435005.text: <style="highlight">Wisteria vine</style>! Yes, we should be able to find some around here.
choice_prompt:7:1028435005.source_cn: 对了，<style=highlight>紫豆藤</style>！这附近应该就能找到。

say:8:1028435006:1.text: No! With the Deer Spirit as my witness, I did not listen to a single word in class! I learned this by traveling around the Dark Forest.
say:8:1028435006:1.source_cn: 不不不，鹿灵的双眼见证，上课的时候我一句也没听！这些是...

say:9:1028435007:1.text: One time when I was sleeping, those furry little thieves ate all the fruit that I had prepared for the road!
say:9:1028435007:1.source_cn: 那些毛茸茸的小窃贼，趁我在树荫下睡觉时，把我打包好准备...

say:10:1028435008:1.text: When I was woozy from hunger, I found the gleamtails gathering around the wisteria vines. I couldn't help myself either. The vines tasted terrible, but at least I didn't go hungry.
say:10:1028435008:1.source_cn: 饿得头晕眼花找东西吃的时候，我发现那些荧尾鼠总是聚集在...

choice:7:0:1.text: You must've been a good student.
choice:7:0:1.male: You must've been a good student.
choice:7:0:1.female: You must've been a good student.

choice:7:1:2.text: You remembered a lot from school.
